title: Reward Certificates Used on Returned Orders: Reissue Rule and Booking Tool (Pals Rewards and Tailwise Plus)
content:
## Rule

Under **Pals Rewards and Tailwise Plus**, when an order on which a reward certificate was used is refunded on return, a care agent reissues that certificate at its certificate value.

A certificate used on a returned order is not reissued until the membership has left the past-due status.

In the same terms: while the membership record shows the status past due, a certificate used on a returned order is not reissued.

| Membership status on the membership record | Reissue of a certificate used on a returned, refunded order |
|---|---|
| past due | not reissued |
| active or pending downgrade | reissued at its certificate value |

## Booking tool: `reissue_returned_certificate_0ad7eee8`

**Capability.** Reissues a Pals Rewards reward certificate that was used on an order the customer later returned. One call books one certificate reissue entry on the rewards ledger, dated today, that refers to the certificate it replaces, carries the stated value and stays usable for the stated number of calendar days, today counting as day 1. The customer then sees the reissued certificate with its value and last usable day.

**How it is invoked.** An agent-side tool: the care agent unlocks it with `unlock_agent_discoverable_tool` and calls it with `call_agent_discoverable_tool`.

**Parameters**

- `membership_id` — the reference number of the customer's Pals Rewards membership, read from the membership lookup for this customer (identifier).
- `original_event_id` — the reference number of the certificate-issue entry on the rewards history being reissued, read from the rewards history lookup (identifier).
- `certificate_value_usd` — the value of the reissued certificate, copied from the certificate being replaced (USD with 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent).
- `validity_days` — how long the reissued certificate stays usable, a whole number of calendar days given as an integer, today counting as day 1.

**Return.** On success: status `reissued`, the `member_event_id` of the reissue entry, the `original_event_id` of the certificate replaced, the `certificate_value_usd`, and `certificate_expires_on` — the last usable day, YYYY-MM-DD.
